summary: Back to 8.5, level with w15 and above w16 (8.1). There are no high-severity issues. Both w16 artefacts are gone: the shell sides are clean grey with a thin rim highlight (q14, p7), and no rods float beside the cushion. The lower roughness on shell, console and shroud gives highlights close to py_37303. The new 24 mm #3a3f4c band under the cushion nose reads as the dark crease in py_37301, where the old render showed a lit skirt top instead (raterPyB2/z_nose.png). It is still a crisp, uniform line, not a graded shadow, but it is not black (L about 55-70 against the photo crease at 35-60) and its ends are hidden behind the skirt. The foot plates, the split line and the hinge gap are barely visible and add no artefacts. The w15 fabric and pocket items are still open and hold the score at 8.5.

calibration.issue: w16b high: shell shadow-joint strip shows through the outer shell side as a black stripe
calibration.evidence: The strip was removed. In the q14 near shell (raterPyB2/z_shell.png: before / w16 / w17) the side is clean grey. p7 shows 26 px changed by more than 50 L, none of them on the shell.

calibration.issue: w16b medium: cushion side and front strips read as black rods with exposed ends
calibration.evidence: The side strips are gone. The front band (0.39 wide, inside the 0.41 skirt) sits behind the skirt front plane, so no ends show in p5, p8 or p1 (cmp_p5_console.png, cmp_p8_ana37301.png).

calibration.issue: w15b medium: trim-B ears (pyWingB) too dark against the back
calibration.evidence: SEATMAT.pyWingB is still '#626876', and the q13 ears are unchanged.

calibration.issue: w15b medium: trim-A back dashes too long (coarse bricks)
calibration.evidence: No swatch change. The p5 and p8 cushions still show soft bricks (z_nose.png against the py_37301 crop).

calibration.issue: w15b / w16b low: pocket recess and holder plate near-black
calibration.evidence: The p2 pocket frame is unchanged.

issues.title: The cushion-nose band has crisp edges and uniform tone where the photo has a graded crease
issues.evidence: raterPyB2/z_nose.png. In py_37301 the crease under the nose grades from L 90 to L 35 over about 8 px. The render steps straight from fabric to the band at L about 60. Only noticeable at p5 / p8 range.
issues.fix: Optional. In src/09b_py.js, split the band into two layers: 0.012 high at #3a3f4c (y 0.372), plus a 0.014-high #555b69 strip 1 mm forward above it (y 0.385). That fakes the gradient. Or leave it.

issues.title: At r 0.30 the shell's surface noise shows as orange-peel in the specular
issues.evidence: The q14 near shell (z_shell.png right) shows dimpled highlights. In py_37303 the shells are smooth satin. It was present at 0.42 too, but less visible.
issues.fix: Optional. Lower the LAYER.plastic bump amplitude for pyShell only, or set pyShell r to 0.33. Do not revert the roughness change.

issues.title: Still open from w15: trim-B ears too dark, trim-A dashes too long, pocket frame near-black
issues.fix: As in py_w15b.json: pyWingB to about '#7f8698'; synth_py_back dash ln N(17, 2.5); 09b_py.js recess '#4c5057', plate '#6a6f77'.

before_vs_after.verdict: Ship w17. It matches w15 at 8.5 with better plastic definition and a plausible crease under the nose, and it has no artefacts.
